summary: A profile of Chef Liang Zhao and his wok stir-frying practice at the restaurant "Flame's Embrace", which opened September 15, 2023. It covers the wok's history, seasoning, ingredient prep, heat control, utensils, tableware, nutrition, consistency, fusion dishes and home cooking. Zhao presents stir-frying as a precise, rhythmic performance built on tradition and innovation.
one_line: Profile of Chef Liang Zhao's wok stir-frying methods at Flame's Embrace, from seasoning and heat control to fusion dishes and home cooking tips.
key_facts: Chef Liang Zhao has worked with the wok at his restaurant "Flame's Embrace" since it opened on September 15, 2023.
Chef Zhao is originally from Guangdong province and says the wok's history dates back to the Han Dynasty.
The wok suits stir-frying because of its high sides and rounded bottom, which allow quick cooking and even heat distribution.
Zhao's favorite wok was crafted on October 3, 2023, by a master wok-maker in Yunnan.
Chef Zhao seasoned the wok on October 11 by coating it with oil and heating it until it smokes, creating a naturally non-stick surface.
On October 21, SousChef Anna Lin demonstrated chopping ingredients uniformly so they cook evenly.
Zhao's sequence for adding ingredients is proteins first, then vegetables, and finally aromatics.
Chef Zhao uses a chuan (spatula) acquired on December 1, saying "It's an extension of my hand."
On December 15, the restaurant unveiled a new line of handcrafted ceramics to complement its dishes.
On January 5, Nutritionist Emily Wong said at a cooking demo that "The quick cooking process retains more nutrients while requiring less oil."
Consistency checks have been implemented in the kitchen since February 10.
On March 1, Zhao embraced fusion cuisine, presenting a dish combining Szechuan pepper with Argentinean chimichurri.
On March 18, during a community cooking class, Zhao told home cooks they need a good wok, fresh ingredients, and the courage to play with fire.
The restaurant held its grand opening gala on November 22.
